SELECT o.id::text AS id,o.name,o.code,o.status FROM (
SELECT id,name,agent_key AS code,status FROM nw_agents WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions wt WHERE wt.tenant_id=nw_agents.tenant_id AND wt.agent_id=nw_agents.id) SELECT id,workflow_id AS name,workflow_id AS code,status FROM nw_workflow_containers WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions wt WHERE wt.tenant_id=nw_workflow_containers.tenant_id AND wt.container_id=nw_workflow_containers.id) SELECT id,name,id::text AS code,status FROM nw_knowledge_bases WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenantId} AS bigint) SELECT CAST(NULL AS bigint) AS id,'' AS name,'' AS code,'' AS status WHERE false
) o WHERE true
AND o.id::text IN #{id} AND false

SELECT CAST(NULL AS bigint) AS id,'' AS name,'' AS code,'' AS status WHERE false
